Generic 2D placeholder UI kit; art direction undecided; neutral grey plus one accent.

Create a generic 2D placeholder UI kit for a Unity game, art direction intentionally undefined. One 9-slice panel, one 9-slice button in normal/hover/disabled, horizontal health and stamina bars with fill and frame, and eight monochrome icons: settings, inventory, map, sound, pause, close, arrow, confirm. Neutral greys plus a single accent colour, 2px stroke, SVG source with PNG exports at 1x and 2x, no text labels.
